name: Panel Hinges / Pintle Hinges
summary: Lift-off panel hinges in extruded nickel chrome plated brass with stainless steel inserts, standard sizes APH 440 to APH 900. RoHS compliant.
intro: Panel hinges (lift-off type) are made from extruded brass rod, polished and nickel chrome plated, with stainless steel inserts and Phillips-recessed hexagonal head screws, zinc plated.
We cover all the standard dimensions used by panel board manufacturers worldwide and can offer variations to your requirement. All products in this category are RoHS compliant.
